decided: 2026-11-23, before any phase-A development episode and before any H1 episode
basis: measured render/collection cost only (no model, no label statistics): validation/task/learned_perception_v1/phaseA_identity_on.json vs phaseA_identity_off.json, dev indices 0-2, 3 parallel workers
decision: Keep the every-tick HD twin (no fallback). HD rendering is about 3 s of a ~15 s (~19 %) overhead per episode including aux views and compression; about 165 MB per episode in total, ~0.55 TB for 3300 episodes, within the 931 GB F: drive.
